about: Capsule prizes carried over from the original NASFAQ (ItemCatalogue.ts). Seasonal items (Christmas, New Year, Valentine's, Easter, the anniversary certificate), the Honk items and the licenses are left out; Halloween is in. Items that were never in the old gacha (event and special items) are here but inactive, so an admin can switch them on. `weight` is the relative pull weight: together they aim at roughly 55% common, 30% rare, 13.5% epic, 1.5% legendary before pity. Portfolio themes (type portfolio_theme) carry their colours and pattern in metadata.theme and restyle the owner's profile page. Seed with api/scripts/seed-gacha-prizes.js.
